user.title: BL Car Tracker
user.description: Create the integration, then add persons and vehicles from its page.

user.title: Add a person
user.description: Link a person to their phone's Bluetooth sensor (Companion app). Every person can drive the position of every vehicle. If several phones are connected to a vehicle, the first person added wins.

reconfigure.title: Edit a person
reconfigure.description: Link a person to their phone's Bluetooth sensor (Companion app).

user.title: Add a vehicle
user.description: A vehicle is identified by the Bluetooth MAC address of its on-board device (head unit, hands-free kit...).

reconfigure.title: Edit a vehicle
reconfigure.description: A vehicle is identified by the Bluetooth MAC address of its on-board device (head unit, hands-free kit...).

error.invalid_mac: Invalid MAC address. Expected format: AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
